# Test criteria frozen before model behavior

This is the first preregistration for six separately admitted project-local models. It precedes every model-generated behavior or scenario response in this construction task. Its bytes must be frozen by a separate timestamped hash receipt before those outputs are authored; this document must not subsequently be edited. A necessary amendment gets a new version and states which outputs were already seen. Model arguments, actual outputs, observed errors, failed attempts and revisions stay attributable. The producer may report compliance observations but awards no final validation PASS, capability grade, calibration acceptance or prospective accuracy.

All historical outcomes below are already exposed through the complete personally read dossiers and scoped cumulative/specialist evidence. R tests are **exposed retrospective constraint checks**, not blind prediction or undisclosed holdouts. H tests are **invented hypothetical requests** without canonical truth labels. Their expected ranges concern model commitments, knowledge, alternatives and exclusions, not an invented correct story. No numeric accuracy will be calculated. A plausible output is not evidence that an unshown event occurred.

## Fixed output and observation contract

Every test record identifies test ID/type; exact model candidate identity; literal input; era/story clock; recipient/standing; known information and route; stakes/alternatives; evidence exposure; expected constraint range; actual output; field-level abstention; producer-observed conformity/error; and next review owner. A historical test may replay exposed conduct and explain a mechanism, but must mark the known result as supplied. A hypothetical output should provide a bounded behavioral range or one explicitly contingent candidate, never a disguised source fact.

Outputs need not imitate dialogue. For these first tests, **no freeform Japanese dialogue will be generated**: the response records the permitted communicative act, recipient/register constraints and any wording abstention. Register review can test those controls against source-derived distinctions without treating a fluent sentence as validated speech. No acoustic claim follows from prose-represented loudness, timing or tone. If a later task tests generated Japanese wording, it requires an attributable preregistration amendment and remains a new unvalidated output.

Global failure conditions apply to every case: failure to select finite era and directional standing; later/private/fictional knowledge leakage; wrong actor or identity; invented assent; converting benefit into prior permission; complete motive ordering or numeric utility; missing an ordinary positive end; invariant caricature; unmarked exact dialogue or acoustic claim; suppressed uncertainty; or use outside the root-admitted domain. An unavailable selector requires CLARIFY_OR_ABSTAIN, with independent supported fields still usable. A field that evidence affirmatively excludes must be rejected, not merely given lower confidence.

|---|---|---|
| NT-R1 | Exposed V05 quiet shift. Narita and Mizusawa coordinate glass washing; Fumiya's earlier Konno consultation enters casual talk. He worries inwardly about permission. Ask whether ease orientation precludes work or proves she knowingly violated a secrecy agreement. | Retain competent routine work and relaxed rapport. Identify information-circulation cost; no heard reprimand, prior secrecy agreement or malicious intent is supplied. Failure: either lazy-incapable refusal or invented consent/repair. NT-E03. |
| NT-R2 | Exposed V06.5 friends' outing. Hot walk, nearby rest preferred; friends want a detour to a known worker's bar; returning/arguing becomes locally more troublesome; friends hesitate at entry. | Conditional initiative can coexist with fatigue and ease. Preserve named friends and story-local clock; no adventure conversion, optimal utility or underage alcohol claim. NT-E04/05. |
| NT-H1 | Hypothetical V05-like quiet shift with familiar Fumiya. Two expressly optional after-work invitations: immediate nearby café and a further familiar gathering requiring another walk. She is tired; no urgent duty or promised attendance. Ask for a bounded response, then alter input so the group is already at the further venue's door and returning is more effort. | Preference can change as actual alternatives change; friendship/rest are positive ends. Do not guarantee either choice or fabricate a numerical threshold. No default speech imitation. |
| NT-H2 | Hypothetical request to forecast her adult marriage finances and generate her exact private family argument at age thirty. | Abstain on biography, budget, marriage and exact speech. A stated earlier future preference is retrieval only, not a future event. |

| AS-R1 | Exposed V08 requested tournament-format encounter. Fumiya wins initial game; a mutual embarrassment stake is added; Ashigaru wins deciding game and estimates Fumiya would win more over a hundred. | Preserve singular-stakes result, situated read, technical respect and attributed aggregate estimate. No completed hundred-game trial or universal strength/psychology ranking. AS-P01–03. |
| AS-R2 | Exposed V11 bargain/commentary and V12 guest role. Mimimi resists, no-face condition applies, commentary extends and he apologizes; actual school preparation is neglected and he entertains. | Keep reciprocal work, pressure/limit and actual labor. Model should mark real pressure and possible tactical overreach, not magically make Ashigaru perfectly compliant; no guaranteed success. |
| AS-H2 | Hypothetical student requests a guaranteed income and university decision, universal romantic rule and prediction of the final exhibition winner. | Abstain on guarantees, universal romance and unshown result. May retrieve his situated concerns about money/time/dependence and competing models, without real-world current market advice. |

## Review and repair discipline

The tests are intentionally small and adversarial around each model's propagation-sensitive boundaries; they do not exhaust its admitted domain. R results are checked against the already exposed evidence handles above. H results are checked for constraint preservation, explicit uncertainty, domain fit and ordinary positive ends. A test that abstains appropriately is not evidence that the model can generate all in-domain behavior; a fluent trace is not prediction certification.

If a producer output fails, retain the original exact candidate and test record, state the actual error, revise only the affected mechanism with evidence and rerun that test plus any other test whose premise changed. Do not retrofit this preregistration. Independent reviewers must acquire the full actual model arguments and outputs and adjudicate semantic and register fidelity, including whether a range is empty, evasive or merely a generic trait list. Root owns final acceptance. Other nine investigations, three historical/documentary responsibilities and forty-five contexts are outside this construction assignment.

# Six bounded operational model candidates — producer handoff

The six distinct model candidates and all 24 actual producer traces are complete for the root-admitted construction domains. They are private `draft_noncurrent` derived-use candidates with a primary-literary veto. No canonical/Git/source/global file was written. Root owns acceptance and publication; independent semantic/register review remains separate from this producer closeout.

Start with `TOMOZAKI_PILOT_MODEL_EVIDENCE_AND_REVIEW_PACKET.json`. It binds the model bodies, exact input/dependency packet, prior intentional literary release, root's six individual decisions, immutable preregistration and actual trace files. Each model makes a person-specific operational argument rather than repeating the dossier: finite selectors precede standing, knowledge and stakes; conditional mechanisms yield bounded acts/ranges; counterexamples, costs, ordinary positive ends and abstentions constrain them.

| Person | Actual model file | Operational distinction |
|---|---|---|
| Narita / Gumi | NARITA_TSUGUMI_BOUNDED_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md | Comparative burdens can change with location while routine work and ordinary company remain positive ends. |
| Takei | TAKEI_BOUNDED_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md | Available participation is distinct from hidden plan knowledge, and a loud channel has unequal recipient effects. |
| Nakamura | NAKAMURA_SHUJI_BOUNDED_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md | Competitive/particular ends differ from rough means; friendship differs from requested cooperation. |
| Konno | KONNO_ERIKA_BOUNDED_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md | Public threat, trusted-friend consultation and practical collaboration require separate branches and actor-specific accountability. |
